claims.claim: Apollo returned Haarish Chowdhary for the exact LinkedIn URL with high match confidence.
claims.evidence: Apollo accepted the exact URL and the harishchowdhary spelling variant and returned the same person record.

claims.claim: Apollo says the person is a Dubai-based C-suite professional.
claims.evidence: Apollo person data lists Dubai, United Arab Emirates, C-suite department and a high match score. Apollo is a data service, not an employer.

claims.claim: Apollo shows an older work history at J.P. Morgan, Northern Trust, Adroit/Keenai and EWA.
claims.evidence: Apollo returns dated employment rows from August 2003 through a current EWA row from May 2025.

claims.claim: The Apollo EWA company match is not the Dubai EWA described in public pages.
claims.evidence: Apollo attaches EWA to Egypt, logistics, maritime and warehousing, founded 1968, about 120 staff. The public LinkedIn EWA page describes EWA Investments Strategies in Dubai, founded 2025, 2–10 employees.

claims.claim: The public EWA LinkedIn page links Haarish to EWA content.
claims.evidence: The page reposts Haarish’s UAE Stories article and a Haarish post. It lists only Keith Nettles as an employee.

claims.claim: The EWA domain exists but does not prove a regulated business.
claims.evidence: ewa.group loads a generic page with a contact form and no captured legal name, licence, owners or named team.

claims.claim: Apolonia publicly presents Haarish as Managing Director and Head of Wealth Management & Multi-Family Office.
claims.evidence: Apolonia’s own biography gives this title and describes more than 23 years of experience.

claims.claim: CEOInsights supports the older J.P. Morgan, Northern Trust and Adroit Vantage story.
claims.evidence: The article names Harish Chowdhary as Chief Product Officer at Adroit Vantage and discusses J.P. Morgan and Northern Trust work.

claims.claim: Haarish publicly said he left Adroit Vantage/Keenai after four years on 3 May 2025.
claims.evidence: The accessible public LinkedIn article says his time with Adroit Vantage, also called Keenai, had come to a close after four years.

claims.claim: Keenai’s current site does not list Haarish on its captured leadership page.
claims.evidence: The captured Keenai About page lists current leadership names but not Haarish. This does not prove he was never a leader or founder.

claims.claim: CRD 308977 is not proof of Haarish’s or Dubai EWA’s licence.
claims.evidence: The official SEC/IAPD record identifies CRD 308977 as EWA, LLC / Equilibrium Wealth Advisors, a different U.S. firm. A data directory mixed that record with a Dubai EWA description.

claims.claim: The full LinkedIn profile could not be read without sign-in.
claims.evidence: Clean Chromium requests to the profile, experience page and activity page returned LinkedIn authwall pages with HTTP 999.

claims.claim: The bounded official and adverse searches found no clear exact-name match.
claims.evidence: The reviewed exact-name searches did not produce a clear identity-matched result in SEC/IAPD, FINRA, SEC filings, OFAC, UAE CMA, DFSA, ADGM or Indian court search results. Existing workspace evidence also records no exact OFAC/UN/SEBI match.

claims.claim: The public record does not prove Haarish is a statutory Apolonia board member.
claims.evidence: Public material shows an operating title. No appointment paper was found, and the reviewed CMA record did not display him among the reviewed board or accredited-employee entries.

limits: No private contact data is retained.
No search non-result is a clean-record certificate.
Apollo data still needs employer and regulator confirmation.
